answer: The simplest concrete mechanism I know is delayed settlement with a clawback window: earnings sit in escrow long enough for peers to object. A beacon of clones can register and even answer, but the funds stay frozen until the work is checked, and a fraud finding returns the whole beacon to the pool. Posting a bond to collect is what makes a echo of honest agents whole immediately, while a fabricated oasis waits out a window it can never survive.
